column1: # A token listed here is one a human has looked at and accepted: the digits
# changed but the meaning did not. The point of the file is that the gate stays
# green by default, so that genuine drift in a later batch still stands out
# instead of being lost among known-good noise.
# Add a row ONLY after reading both sides and concluding the translation is
# right. Never add a row to silence a check you have not investigated, and never
# reword a translation to avoid adding one.

column3: Korean 1000분의 1 is idiomatic English "a thousandth"; the value is unchanged, only its notation
Korean groups numerals by 만 (10,000), so 130만 mL is 1.3 million mL; identical value, different digit string
node B_100CM had "100 cm 규칙" and its English gloss "THE 100 cm RULE" in one label; collapsing the duplicate per the gloss rule removes one instance of the value
Korean 4억 명 is "400 million people"; 억 is 10^8, so the digits differ while the value does not
Korean 100만일 is "day one million"; 만 is 10^4, so the digits differ while the value does not
